title: StrategyHoldingsBlended
description: Standardized Tier 4 Consolidated Strategy Holdings Portfolio with Weighted Average Cost (WAC), pooled multi-currency cash balances, and lot-level account attribution.

strategy_id.description: Identifier of the Investment Way matching config/investment_ways.yaml (e.g. fundamental_lts, fundamental_foreign).

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the blended portfolio was generated.

base_currency.description: Strategy base currency code (e.g. INR, USD) used for valuation and cash pooling.

total_invested.description: Consolidated invested capital across all blended positions in base currency.

total_current_value.description: Consolidated current market value across all blended positions in base currency.

unrealized_pnl.description: Total unrealized profit or loss in strategy base currency.

unrealized_pnl_pct.description: Total unrealized return percentage across all positions.

pooled_cash.description: Total available settled liquid cash pooled across all assigned accounts in base currency.

total_strategy_equity.description: Total strategy portfolio equity (total_current_value + pooled_cash) in base currency.

positions_count.description: Total count of unique consolidated equity positions.

accounts_blended.description: Audit record of all underlying broker accounts blended into this strategy portfolio.

account_id.description: Identifier of the account matching config/investment_ways.yaml.

raw_cash.description: Original available cash in account currency.

fx_rate.description: Exchange rate applied to convert this account's currency to strategy base currency.

pooled_cash_contribution.description: Cash contribution in strategy base currency (raw_cash * fx_rate).

holdings_count.description: Number of positions contributed by this account.

positions.description: Consolidated positions with blended Weighted Average Cost and lot attribution.

ticker.description: Canonical exchange ticker symbol (e.g. INFY, AAPL, VOO).

name.description: Display name of company or fund.

exchange.description: Primary exchange (e.g. NSE, BSE, NASDAQ, NYSE).

quantity.description: Consolidated total quantity across all accounts (supports fractional shares).

average_price.description: Weighted Average Cost (WAC) per share in strategy base currency.

cmp.description: Current Market Price per share in strategy base currency.

invested_value.description: Total invested cost in strategy base currency (quantity * average_price).

current_value.description: Current market valuation in strategy base currency (quantity * cmp).

unrealized_pnl.description: Consolidated unrealized profit or loss in strategy base currency.

attribution.description: Lot-level breakdown detailing the contributing accounts for this position.

quantity.description: Quantity held in this specific account.

average_price.description: Average purchase price in account's original currency.

fx_rate.description: FX rate applied to convert original currency to strategy base currency.

cost_in_base_currency.description: Purchase cost per share converted to base currency (average_price * fx_rate).

invested_value_base.description: Invested value of this lot in base currency (quantity * cost_in_base_currency).

current_value_base.description: Current market value of this lot in base currency.

weight_in_position_pct.description: Percentage contribution of this lot to the total position quantity.
